content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Does anyone know the maximum capacity of an SD card that can be used in the newest [product_name]? I couldn't find this information in the manual. Thanks
If formatted with FAT32, the SD card can be up to 32GB. Since the micro-SD-card must use the FAT32 format, this is the maximum size supported by [product_name] [article_no].

Hi, that's correct. The manual for [product_name] mentions a minimum SD card specification. I read replies from [company_name] experts—one recommends exFAT, another FAT32, and another suggests the ideal maximum is 32GB. I tested several card capacities and both formats but still couldn't get the card to work with [product_name] [version_no]. The manual should provide more detail on compatible SD card manufacturers, formats, and capacities for reliable use. Best regards, [user_name]

As I mentioned before in another discussion, I have used several SD cards from different manufacturers with various capacities and never encountered problems. There's no need for [company_name] to specify brands—the specifications in the manual are adequate. You are responding to a very old thread. At that time, only FAT32 formatting was possible, exFAT was not supported.

Hello. I'll check what the second [product_name] does. I returned the previous one, which couldn't recognize any SD card, to the seller. It's problematic when diagnostics repeatedly indicate 'card not present' even with multiple SD cards.
I've owned all [article_no] series of [product_name], from the earliest version in 2014 to the current [version_no], and have never experienced any issues using various SD cards across all devices.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for clear information on the maximum SD card capacity and supported file formats for [product_name], especially [article_no] models. Manuals are seen as lacking details about compatible brands, file systems, and error diagnostics. Inconsistent recognition of SD cards and unclear error messages contribute to user frustration and uncertainty.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect comprehensive manual guidance on SD card compatibility, capacities, and formats, along with more precise diagnostics. They want reliable SD card recognition and straightforward error reporting from the device.
